newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nichiei Co shares up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Nichiei Co shares up on speculative buying.

text.p: Shares in lumber dealer Nichiei Co Ltd were higher on Tuesday afternoon, lifted by speculative buying, brokers said.
The shares, which were the seventh most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, were 23 yen higher at 364 yen at 0515 GMT. Turnover was 2.4 million shares.
"The burden of the collapse of its unit Nichiei Finance Co Ltd is not staggering and some investors are buying on hopes that the share price will rebound," one broker said.
